data.one_liner: Mediation adapter for Meta Audience Network using google_mobile_ads.
data.what_it_does: Enables sending ad requests to the Meta Audience Network ad network through the google_mobile_ads plugin. It provides the necessary mediation adapter code for Android and iOS platforms.
use_when: You are using google_mobile_ads in your Flutter app and want to include Meta Audience Network in your ad mediation waterfall.
You need to serve Meta Audience Network ads alongside Google AdMob or Ad Manager ads.
avoid_when: You are not using the google_mobile_ads plugin.
You do not use ad mediation or Meta Audience Network in your monetization strategy.
strengths: Official Google mediation adapter for Meta Audience Network.
Seamless integration with the google_mobile_ads plugin ecosystem.
weaknesses: Dependent on keeping synchronized with specific Google Mobile Ads plugin versions and native adapters.
Limited functionality on its own without the core Google Mobile Ads plugin.
data.setup_notes: Requires configuration of both the google_mobile_ads plugin and Meta Audience Network SDK requirements on Android and iOS.

alternatives.name: applovin_max
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative ad mediation platform if you prefer AppLovin MAX over Google AdMob mediation.
